description: Hi, I’m Liyan, a computer science student from Bangladesh interested in space science, game development and AI. I build games in C++ and OpenGL, and for this challenge I built Space Mission, a 5-level educational space shooter based on real NASA asteroid missions (Bennu, Apophis, Psyche, Dimorphos, Arrokoth). I ported it to run in the browser using WebAssembly and added an AI Astronomer that explains each discovery and answers players’ questions.
